name: Coleman Maker 3rd
original_name: コールマン・メイカー3世
source:
A nurse, called 'Doctor' by those around him.
He's an old acquaintance of [url=/c45811]Acid[/url].
He used to be a much more serious guy but he got into an accident and lately he's always drinking alcohol at a sidewalk cafe.
